quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
كٓهيعٓصٓ
ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّۭا
قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا
وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا
يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّۭا
قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا
قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا
فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا
وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا
وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا
قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا
قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا
قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا
فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا
فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا
فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا
فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا
يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا
فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا
قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا
وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا
وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا
وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا
يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا
يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا
قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا
قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا
وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا
فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا
وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا
وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا
وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا

أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩
۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا
جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا
لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا
رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا
وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا
ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا
ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا
وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا
وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا
وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا

قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا
وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا
أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا
أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا
وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا
وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا
كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا
فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا
يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًۭا
وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا
لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا
لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا
تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًۭا
وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًۭا
لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا
وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا
فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا
وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا

parent_channels.name: P1 (19:1-15) - Guarded Continuity Across Bodily Limits

subchannels.name: The aging body as a failing, ignited structure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A load-bearing frame weakens while whiteness spreads across its top like flame, snow, or frost.
subchannels.active_motifs: spent bodily force (`quranic:root_001687:B001/m01`); painful rib-and-shoulder frame (`quranic:root_001687:B003/m01`); hard bone (`quranic:root_001029:B005/m01`); head or uppermost part (`quranic:root_000529:B001/m01`); kindled flame (`quranic:root_000799:B001/m01`); white blaze across the forelock (`quranic:root_000799:B002/m01`); snow-whitened summits (`quranic:root_000833:B002/m01`); extended old age (`quranic:root_001281:B004/m01`); terminal senescence beyond repair (`quranic:root_000981:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:4 (و ه ن, ع ظ م, ر ء س, ش ع ل, ش ي ب); 19:8 (ك ب ر, ع ت و)
subchannels.synthesis: Zechariah's weakness is materially rendered as a frame whose bone, ribs, and upper member can no longer carry their former load. The head's grayness is not static color but a spreading ignition that also resembles frost on a summit, while old age names a terminal state that ordinary repair cannot reverse.

subchannels.name: Household office and inheritance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A household seeks a successor who can receive property, knowledge, care, and governing responsibility.
subchannels.active_motifs: household and dependents gathered around a man (`quranic:root_000067:B003/m01`); inherited estate (`quranic:root_001639:B001/m01`); inherited knowledge or scripture (`quranic:root_001639:B003/m01`); guardianship and management (`quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`); kinship, manumission, and legal affiliation (`quranic:root_001684:B005/m01`); gradual nurture to completion (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); unpriced gift (`quranic:root_001685:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The requested heir belongs to a complete transfer scene: an estate and a body of knowledge pass onward, but so do the obligations of guardianship and patient cultivation. Gift language prevents the succession from becoming a mere transaction, while the household and legal senses of kinship show why the heir must be able to stand in an office, not simply extend a bloodline.

subchannels.name: Human gestation, birth, and early care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A blocked womb becomes a prepared site of birth, tenderness, growth, and filial care.
subchannels.active_motifs: womb as the child's enclosed growing place (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); human barrenness as interrupted generation (`quranic:root_001035:B004/m01`); a gift made ready in advance (`quranic:root_001685:B005/m01`); human childbirth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); newborn or very young child (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); protective tenderness (`quranic:root_000364:B001/m01`); organic growth and increase (`quranic:root_000637:B001/m01`); purification and soundness (`quranic:root_000637:B002/m01`); active care for parents and kin (`quranic:root_000104:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The answer to barrenness is staged as more than conception. The womb is a bounded place of growth; the gift is prepared; birth opens into tenderness, purification, and reciprocal care. This makes John's ethical formation part of the same generative process as his bodily formation.

subchannels.name: Herd birth and weaning as a pastoral mirror
subchannels.scene_or_process: A recently delivered dam remains near shelter and milk, longs for its young, and eventually has the young separated from the adults.
subchannels.active_motifs: ewe near parturition and kept home for milk (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); immature camel or cow (`quranic:root_000143:B003/m01`); dam longing for home or offspring (`quranic:root_000364:B002/m01`); animal barrenness (`quranic:root_001035:B004/m02`); animal parturition (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m02`); separating young stock from the mature herd (`quranic:root_001684:B015/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The human birth story is usefully pressured by a complete husbandry cycle: infertility, pregnancy, a dam held near milk and shelter, attachment to the young, and eventual weaning. The pastoral scene materializes continuity as managed dependence rather than an instantaneous miracle.

subchannels.name: Birth, death, and reawakening as three protected thresholds
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person crosses birth, death, and renewed life under a repeated grant of safety.
subchannels.active_motifs: bounded day (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`); human birth (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); loss of life and force (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); stirring a recumbent or dormant being (`quranic:root_000129:B001/m01`); animate life (`quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`); safety from defect and harm (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:15 (ي و م, و ل د, م و ت, ب ع ث, ح ي ي, س ل م)
subchannels.synthesis: The three named days are three crossings rather than a generic lifespan. Birth introduces embodied life, death removes force, and resurrection stirs what lies still; peace functions as protection at each exposed boundary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life is carried forward by transferring care, office, and vitality across a failing bodily threshold.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; Zechariah's aged body and barren household frame the requested heir (19:4-8), while John receives care, authority, and a threefold life-cycle blessing (19:12-15).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The lineage scene expands into structural fatigue, animal husbandry, and the reanimation of something recumbent.

parent_channels.name: P1 (19:1-15) - Signals Emerging From Concealment

subchannels.name: Private call, suspended speech, and nonverbal relay
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed appeal is answered by a sign that redirects communication from ordinary speech to gesture and encoded indication.
subchannels.active_motifs: vocal call that inclines a hearer (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); raised and far-carrying voice (`quranic:root_001486:B002/m01`); concealment and secrecy (`quranic:root_000428:B001/m01`); hidden transfer of knowledge (`quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`); gesture or sign without explicit speech (`quranic:root_001633:B002/m01`); inscription or written mark (`quranic:root_001633:B003/m01`); subtle sound (`quranic:root_001633:B005/m01`); intelligible exchange between speakers (`quranic:root_001316:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The passage moves through a graded communication system: private calling, withheld ordinary speech, bodily indication, and a relay to the community. The lexical range of revelation joins gesture, writing, hidden sound, and secretly delivered knowledge, so silence becomes a different transmission medium rather than an absence of meaning.

subchannels.name: Night wayfinding from dim signal to dawn
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler crosses the dark part of night by seeking a faint fire or flash until first light.
subchannels.active_motifs: deep night and darkness (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); travel or work by night (`quranic:root_001392:B002/m01`); a waning hour of night (`quranic:root_001687:B002/m01`); first darkness and reduced visibility (`quranic:root_001017:B001/m01`); seeking a night fire for guidance (`quranic:root_001017:B002/m01`); weak lightning emerging from cloud (`quranic:root_000428:B004/m01`); first light and early departure (`quranic:root_000143:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The hidden prayer and the morning-evening instruction activate a complete wayfinding scene. Night is crossed by attending to weak, intermittent signals: a distant fire, a dim flash, and finally dawn. This gives the pericope's signs a navigational function.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Meaning becomes effective by moving from hiddenness into a perceivable but controlled sign.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; a private call opens the pericope (19:3-4), speech is suspended as a sign (19:10), and a silent indication carries instruction to the people (19:11).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The signal system includes faint lightning, night-fire navigation, inscription, gesture, hidden sound, and dawn.

parent_channels.name: P1 (19:1-15) - Authority Through Fastening and Restraint

subchannels.name: Gripping a bound and measured text
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prepared document is measured, joined, and taken by a secure grip.
subchannels.active_motifs: taking and holding (`quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`); handle by which an object is grasped (`quranic:root_000018:B012/m01`); stitching and joining leather into a book (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); strength as gathered rope strands (`quranic:root_001274:B001/m01`); measuring material before cutting (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); three-part cord or skin vessel (`quranic:root_000203:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Taking the Book "with strength" becomes a fabrication-and-grip scene. Material is measured, multiple parts are joined, the binding becomes strong like a cord, and a handle makes the whole object governable by the hand.

subchannels.name: Judgment as bridle, barrier, and repair
subchannels.scene_or_process: Governance restrains destructive motion and restores what has broken without becoming coercive domination.
subchannels.active_motifs: restraint that prevents corruption (`quranic:root_000348:B001/m01`); judgment between people (`quranic:root_000348:B002/m01`); bridle that checks an animal's motion (`quranic:root_000348:B006/m01`); setting a fracture or deficiency right (`quranic:root_000216:B001/m01`); splints bound around a break (`quranic:root_000216:B005/m01`); coercive domination (`quranic:root_000216:B003/m01`); departure from obedience (`quranic:root_001022:B001/m01`); protective barrier against harm (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Judgment is not merely a verdict. Its active shape is a bridle that redirects force, a barrier that prevents injury, and a splint that restores integrity. The rejection of tyranny distinguishes such disciplined repair from domination.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Reliable authority is made operative by joining, gripping, restraining, and repairing.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; John is told to take the Book firmly and is given judgment while still young (19:12), in contrast to coercive arrogance and disobedience (19:14).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Text, strength, and judgment materialize as stitched leather, rope strands, handles, bridles, and splints.

parent_channels.name: P2 (19:16-40) - Screened Emergence Into Visible Form

subchannels.name: Withdrawal, veil, and refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person moves to a remote side, erects a barrier, and seeks protection inside its bounded space.
subchannels.active_motifs: withdrawing to a side (`quranic:root_001466:B004/m01`); remote edge or farthest side (`quranic:root_001235:B001/m01`); preventing access (`quranic:root_000294:B001/m01`); intervening screen (`quranic:root_000294:B002/m01`); internal bodily partition (`quranic:root_000294:B004/m01`); refuge and protected attachment (`quranic:root_001059:B001/m01`); adhering within the shelter of something (`quranic:root_001059:B004/m01`); sunlit eastern sitting place (`quranic:root_000790:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Mary's withdrawal is spatially exact: side, remoteness, screened access, and refuge. The bodily partition sense of the veil reinforces the scene as an enclosure that protects an interior while still permitting a controlled encounter.

subchannels.name: Wind and spirit assuming an upright human surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: An invisible life-bearing current is dispatched and becomes a complete, visible, standing human form.
subchannels.active_motifs: life-bearing spirit (`quranic:root_000609:B001/m01`); wind and moving air (`quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`); dispatch and release (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); message-bearing envoy (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); standing presence (`quranic:root_001397:B005/m01`); modeled or pictured form (`quranic:root_001397:B008/m01`); visible human skin or surface (`quranic:root_000120:B001/m01`); human being as exposed-skinned creature (`quranic:root_000120:B002/m01`); bodily proportion made straight and complete (`quranic:root_000766:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:17 (ر س ل, ر و ح, م ث ل, ب ش ر, س و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The messenger's appearance is a transformation from invisible motion to visible surface. Spirit and wind supply mobile life; dispatch gives direction; modeling and uprightness give shape; exposed human skin makes the form perceptible.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A protected boundary controls passage from hidden or remote space into embodied visibility.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; Mary withdraws eastward and installs a veil before the messenger appears to her in an even human form (19:16-18), then withdraws again to a remote place (19:22).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The passage resembles a controlled threshold through which wind, life, image, and messenger become a standing body.

parent_channels.name: P2 (19:16-40) - Birth Through Churning, Harvest, and Provision

subchannels.name: Gestation as enclosure, settling, and churn
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pregnancy settles in an enclosure, then labor agitates its contents until birth becomes imminent.
subchannels.active_motifs: internal pregnancy or fruit-bearing (`quranic:root_000357:B002/m01`); labor pains and fetal movement (`quranic:root_001406:B002/m01`); liquid agitated inside a skin or vessel (`quranic:root_001406:B001/m01`); ninth-month enclosure (`quranic:root_000294:B010/m01`); seed fixed and pregnancy established (`quranic:root_001215:B013/m01`); premature falling of a fetus (`quranic:root_000719:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Gestation is first a settled, enclosed state and then a controlled disturbance. The liquid-churning sense of labor makes fetal movement and contraction mechanically legible, while the miscarriage sense of falling exposes the risk answered by the promised safe delivery.

subchannels.name: Palm harvest by shaking and downward release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worker grips and shakes a trunk so mature fruit detaches, falls, is gathered, and becomes food.
subchannels.active_motifs: palm trunk (`quranic:root_000231:B002/m01`); vigorous shaking (`quranic:root_001588:B001/m01`); downward falling in succession (`quranic:root_000719:B001/m01`); ripe dates (`quranic:root_000571:B002/m01`); gathering produce from its source (`quranic:root_000267:B001/m01`); tree yield (`quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`); eating (`quranic:root_000043:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is a complete harvest operation rather than a loose cluster of plant images. Motion applied to the trunk releases ripe yield downward; gathering converts the fall into possession; eating completes the fruit's function.

subchannels.name: Stream, spring, and cooled sight
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water appears below the laboring woman, becomes drink and green moisture, and cools both body and eye.
subchannels.active_motifs: lower side beneath the body (`quranic:root_000177:B001/m01`); small running stream and creeping root-water (`quranic:root_000702:B002/m01`); visible spring (`quranic:root_001069:B006/m01`); drinking liquid (`quranic:root_000783:B001/m01`); drinking place or vessel (`quranic:root_000783:B004/m01`); moisture and softness (`quranic:root_000571:B001/m01`); green wet pasture (`quranic:root_000571:B003/m01`); eye cooled into rest (`quranic:root_001215:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:24 (ت ح ت, س ر ي); 19:25 (ر ط ب); 19:26 (ش ر ب, ع ي ن, ق ر ر)
subchannels.synthesis: The promised stream is both hydrological and affective. Water runs below, rises visibly as a spring, feeds moist growth, enters a vessel and body, and finally cools the eye into settled composure.

subchannels.name: Date infusion and rationed drink
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fruit is steeped, milk is diluted, a water share is measured, and the drink is thickened or improved.
subchannels.active_motifs: dates or raisins cast into a water vessel (`quranic:root_001466:B006/m01`); milk diluted by poured water (`quranic:root_001501:B007/m01`); allotted water share (`quranic:root_000783:B002/m01`); thickened syrup used to improve food or skins (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`); recurring turn at water (`quranic:root_000315:B002/m01`); liquid poured at once into a vessel (`quranic:root_001215:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The palm-and-water provision activates a distinct preparation scene. Dates are steeped, liquid is apportioned and poured, and milk or syrup is adjusted in consistency. The process extends nourishment from raw harvest to a managed drink.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Enclosed life becomes manifest through agitation and is then sustained by a coordinated economy of fruit, water, and prepared drink.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; conception and pregnancy lead to labor at the palm, falling ripe dates, eating, drinking, and composure (19:19-26).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Obstetrics, orchard work, irrigation, and beverage preparation form distinct but consecutive operations.

parent_channels.name: P2 (19:16-40) - Public Proof Against Imputed Guilt

subchannels.name: Carrying, exposure, and false accusation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A publicly carried child triggers an accusation about lineage; a gesture redirects the charge toward a new speaker.
subchannels.active_motifs: carrying a visible load (`quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`); carried child of uncertain lineage (`quranic:root_000357:B005/m01`); bringing something into presence (`quranic:root_000281:B004/m01`); assembled kin-group (`quranic:root_001273:B001/m01`); fabricated accusation (`quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`); cutting leather for repair and stitching (`quranic:root_001150:B001/m01`); exposure that produces shame (`quranic:root_000827:B005/m01`); deictic hand gesture (`quranic:root_000827:B004/m01`); speech as bodily wound (`quranic:root_001316:B003/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:27 (ح م ل, ج ي ء, ق و م, ف ر ي); 19:29 (ش و ر, ك ل م)
subchannels.synthesis: The child is both a physical load and the object around which lineage is disputed. The root of the accusation also names skilled cutting and stitching, setting destructive fabrication against repair; Mary's gesture transfers the floor to speech capable of closing the wound.

subchannels.name: Prepared cradle, upright voice, and acknowledgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prepared resting place supports an infant who unexpectedly assumes the social role of an upright declarant.
subchannels.active_motifs: infant's prepared cradle (`quranic:root_001451:B001/m01`); leveled bedding or ground (`quranic:root_001451:B002/m01`); preparation and setting an affair right (`quranic:root_001451:B003/m01`); intelligible speech exchange (`quranic:root_001316:B001/m01`); young child (`quranic:root_000843:B001/m01`); bodily standing and public presence (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); acknowledgment that establishes a claim (`quranic:root_001215:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The cradle is lexically a prepared and leveled base, allowing the infant's speech to function like an upright deposition. Acknowledgment fixes what accusation had left unstable.

subchannels.name: Evidence moves from covered perception to witnessed clarity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hearing, sight, testimony, and explanation converge as concealed truth becomes public evidence.
subchannels.active_motifs: ocular seeing (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); inward discernment (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); auditory reception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); understanding and compliance after hearing (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); witnessed presence (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`); testimony that declares known fact (`quranic:root_000822:B002/m01`); witness as articulating tongue (`quranic:root_000822:B005/m01`); disclosed evidence (`quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`); explanation by speech or sign (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); covering that becomes denial (`quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`); uncovering a protective screen (`quranic:root_000320:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:37 (ب ي ن, ك ف ر, ش ه د); 19:38 (س م ع, ب ص ر); 19:39 (ح س ر)
subchannels.synthesis: The close of the pericope is an evidentiary process. Perception becomes understanding, presence becomes testimony, and sign becomes explanation. Denial remains a covering operation, while the day of regret removes that cover.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A contested person is exposed before a community, then vindicated through embodied indication, speech, and converging evidence.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; Mary carries the child to her people, faces an accusation, points to the cradle, and the child speaks (19:27-33), after which hearing, sight, warning, and judgment dominate the close (19:34-40).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cutting and stitching, bodily wounding, legal acknowledgment, and witness-language materialize the conflict over Mary's reputation.

parent_channels.name: P2 (19:16-40) - Effective Word and Settled Judgment

subchannels.name: Command as completed fabrication
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authoritative utterance measures, makes, and finishes what it orders.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding command or request (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`); decisive decree (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`); finished and effective workmanship (`quranic:root_001237:B005/m01`); bringing something into existence (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); changing it into an appointed state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); articulated saying (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); occurrence in time (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Saying, making, and decreeing are consecutive operations in one effective process. The command supplies obligation, making supplies form, and decree supplies completion, so the utterance's truth is demonstrated by the state it brings about.

subchannels.name: Truth tested through dispute and fitted proof
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rival claims contest a truth that is progressively established, tightened, and fitted into its proper place.
subchannels.active_motifs: truth matching reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); establishing truth by proof (`quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`); tightly woven cloth or exact speech (`quranic:root_000347:B010/m01`); fitted joint or container (`quranic:root_000347:B011/m01`); sharp verbal disputation (`quranic:root_001416:B003/m01`); doubt and hesitation (`quranic:root_001416:B004/m01`); denial of another's right (`quranic:root_001416:B005/m01`); divergent paths and claims (`quranic:root_000433:B004/m01`); faction aligned around an opinion (`quranic:root_000315:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Dispute loosens what truth fixes. The true claim is figured as exact weave and a joint seated in its proper socket, whereas contention pulls parties onto divergent paths. Decree closes the contest by fixing the relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A valid word does not remain descriptive; it determines, fabricates, and settles an outcome.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the child is a sign and a decreed affair (19:21), Jesus is named a word of truth (19:34), and divine saying completes a decreed command (19:35-39).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Command resembles workshop fabrication, while truth resembles tight weave and fitted joint.

parent_channels.name: P3 (19:41-58) - Guidance as Tracked and Truthful Transmission

subchannels.name: Waymarks, leading edge, and followed tracks
subchannels.scene_or_process: A guide supplies visible markers, takes the leading position, and asks another traveler to follow a traceable route.
subchannels.active_motifs: knowledge and recognition (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); road-mark, banner, or boundary marker (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); gentle direction to a road (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); leading edge or advance guide (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); following a person or trace (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); searching footprint after footprint (`quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`); straight road (`quranic:root_000858:B001/m01`); prophecy as a clear, easy road (`quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Abraham's offer of knowledge is a navigation system: knowledge marks the route, the guide occupies its front edge, and following proceeds trace by trace. The road sense of prophecy makes the later prophetic sequence a continuation of the same marked way.

subchannels.name: Call, hidden voice, and confidential relay
subchannels.scene_or_process: A message moves from public call into low voice, confidential audience, and onward delivery.
subchannels.active_motifs: projected call (`quranic:root_001486:B002/m01`); hidden or indistinct prophetic sound (`quranic:root_001464:B006/m01`); confidential speech (`quranic:root_001476:B005/m01`); message-bearing envoy (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); tongue as delivered message (`quranic:root_001355:B008/m01`); written record (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Moses' call and confidential nearness occupy two ends of a vocal spectrum. Low sound and private speech remain fully transmissive because envoy, tongue, and book carry the message beyond the immediate audience.

subchannels.name: Promise fulfilled into durable public reputation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A spoken commitment is completed in action and then persists as an elevated report on the tongue of others.
subchannels.active_motifs: truthful speech (`quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`); solid and straight truth (`quranic:root_000852:B002/m01`); complete and enduring reputation (`quranic:root_000852:B003/m01`); promise fulfilled in action (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); appointed time or place of fulfillment (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); language, report, and praise on tongues (`quranic:root_001355:B006/m01`); raised and circulated report (`quranic:root_000582:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Truth is tested by temporal completion: promise opens an expectation, action closes it, and public speech preserves the result. The resulting "tongue of truth" is not mere fame but a durable relay of fulfilled conduct.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Guidance succeeds when a reliable message is marked, carried, followed, and fulfilled.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; Abraham offers knowledge and a straight path (19:43), the prophetic figures are remembered through book, message, and truthful promise (19:41, 50-56), and signs are recited to their descendants (19:58).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Guidance becomes a road-marker system, prophecy a clear road, and truthful reputation a durable public transmission.

parent_channels.name: P3 (19:41-58) - Ordered Approach and Vertical Response

subchannels.name: Mountain perimeter and privileged audience
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visitor reaches a bounded mountain precinct from one side, crosses its limit, and enters privileged nearness.
subchannels.active_motifs: mountain mass (`quranic:root_000955:B005/m01`); aligned perimeter or forecourt (`quranic:root_000955:B001/m01`); boundary that may not be crossed casually (`quranic:root_000955:B003/m01`); bodily side and spatial flank (`quranic:root_000262:B001/m01`); adjacency and companionship (`quranic:root_000262:B002/m01`); right-hand side (`quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`); right hand as pledge (`quranic:root_001698:B003/m01`); right hand as power and valid claim (`quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`); privileged proximity to a ruler (`quranic:root_001212:B004/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:52 (ج ن ب, ط و ر, ي م ن, ق ر ب)
subchannels.synthesis: The mountain is not only topography. Its lexical perimeter, side, and limit form a court-like precinct; the right side adds pledge and authority, and being brought near names admission to a privileged audience.

subchannels.name: Raising answered by falling, bowing, and tears
subchannels.scene_or_process: Honor lifts a person or station, while encounter with signs draws the body downward into prostration and tears.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical raising (`quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`); elevation of rank (`quranic:root_000582:B002/m01`); spatial height (`quranic:root_001042:B001/m01`); elevated honor (`quranic:root_001042:B002/m01`); downward fall with sound (`quranic:root_000402:B001/m01`); submission with forehead to ground (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); bending under weight (`quranic:root_000675:B004/m01`); bodily bending gathered into prostration (`quranic:root_000220:B006/m01`); tears and voiced weeping (`quranic:root_000146:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:57 (ر ف ع, ك و ن, ع ل و); 19:58 (ج ب ي, خ ر ر, س ج د, ب ك ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The two verses create a deliberate vertical counterpoint. Rank and place rise; the recipient of signs falls. The descent is not loss of status but its bodily answer, completed by audible tears.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Access to authority is choreographed through boundary, side, nearness, elevation, and bodily lowering.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; Moses is called from the mountain's right side and brought near for confidential speech (19:52), Idris is raised high (19:57), and the guided fall in prostration and tears (19:58).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The mountain behaves like a bounded court whose privileged audience is answered by opposite bodily vectors, raising and falling.

parent_channels.name: P3 (19:41-58) - Waterworks of Knowledge and Gift

subchannels.name: Reservoir and rock basin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water collects in a protected depression or stone basin until it becomes an abundant source.
subchannels.active_motifs: large water basin (`quranic:root_000220:B002/m01`); water collecting in a depression or around a fort (`quranic:root_000281:B003/m01`); deep source full of water (`quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`); rain pool held in rock (`quranic:root_001685:B003/m01`); abundant gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The abstract arrival of knowledge and gift is materialized as stored water. A depression receives flow, stone holds it, and abundance turns the enclosed pool into a source that can be approached and drawn from.

subchannels.name: Well-hoist assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: A long twisted rope runs over a raised fitting, using a weight and handled bucket to draw from a well.
subchannels.active_motifs: well weight or stone tied to rope (`quranic:root_000547:B006/m01`); long tightly twisted draw-rope (`quranic:root_000796:B002/m01`); raised anvil or bucket fitting (`quranic:root_001042:B009/m01`); cord lifting a fetter (`quranic:root_000582:B009/m01`); one-handled water bucket (`quranic:root_000737:B011/m01`); bucket handle or balancing side-piece (`quranic:root_000741:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The branches form a complete lifting machine: rope, well weight, elevated bearing, lifting cord, bucket, and handle. It gives concrete mechanics to the pericope's movement from inaccessible source to received knowledge and gift.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Valuable provision is gathered in a bounded reservoir and made accessible through a lifting mechanism.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; knowledge comes to Abraham (19:43), gifts follow his withdrawal (19:49-53), and Moses is called and brought near at the mountain (19:52).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Knowledge, gift, calling, and elevation assemble a reservoir, well head, rope, counterweight, handle, and bucket.

parent_channels.name: P4 (19:59-76) - From Neglected Estate to Restored Garden

subchannels.name: Abandoned estate, scattered work, and hungry young
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inherited property loses coordinated care, its work proliferates beyond management, and dependents go hungry.
subchannels.active_motifs: bad successor replacing a sound predecessor (`quranic:root_000433:B008/m01`); lost or abandoned thing (`quranic:root_000923:B001/m01`); untended estate of land and palms (`quranic:root_000923:B002/m01`); neglected craft or occupation (`quranic:root_000923:B003/m01`); neglected herd management (`quranic:root_000923:B003/m02`); holdings too scattered to manage (`quranic:root_000923:B004/m01`); hungry gut (`quranic:root_000923:B005/m01`); young animal harmed by failed milk intake (`quranic:root_001116:B003/m01`); repeated appetite (`quranic:root_000825:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:59 (خ ل ف, ض ي ع, ش ه و, غ و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The failed generation is rendered as failed estate management. Property, occupation, and herd care are all left without coordination; appetite multiplies while the dependent young is deprived of sustaining milk.

subchannels.name: Prayer abandoned as fire and hunting trap
subchannels.scene_or_process: Leaving disciplined worship exposes a traveler or animal to heat, a set snare, and a concealed pit.
subchannels.active_motifs: meeting the heat of fire (`quranic:root_000879:B001/m01`); hunting snare (`quranic:root_000879:B004/m01`); hunter's death-pit (`quranic:root_001116:B004/m01`); encountering recurrent harm (`quranic:root_001372:B007/m01`); following a trace or leader (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:59 (ت ب ع, ص ل و, ل ق ي, غ و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The neglected prayer root activates both fire and trap, while error supplies the hunter's pit. The consequence is therefore not a generic penalty but a route whose abandoned discipline leaves the follower exposed to capture.

subchannels.name: Enclosed orchard, hidden roots, and inheritance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dense, tree-screened garden receives entrants, water, and heirs while its roots remain hidden below.
subchannels.active_motifs: orchard screened by trees (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); dense and vigorous vegetation (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); entry into an enclosure (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); small bird entering dense growth (`quranic:root_000464:B009/m01`); hidden roots revealed by digging (`quranic:root_001117:B008/m01`); rain as provision (`quranic:root_000560:B003/m01`); inherited estate (`quranic:root_001639:B001/m01`); property granted without transaction (`quranic:root_001639:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Paradise is an actual horticultural system in the lexical field: dense trees form the enclosure, roots hold unseen life, rain supplies growth, and inheritance transfers the cultivated whole to new occupants.

subchannels.name: Quiet soundscape and measured ration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Disorderly noise is excluded while food and peace arrive in a stable morning-evening rhythm.
subchannels.active_motifs: item omitted from an account (`quranic:root_001361:B001/m01`); confused or disruptive noise (`quranic:root_001361:B003/m01`); safety and wholeness (`quranic:root_000737:B001/m01`); peaceful settlement (`quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`); allotted provision (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`); sustaining food (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`); first part of day (`quranic:root_000143:B001/m01`); evening time (`quranic:root_001017:B004/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:62 (س م ع, ل غ و, س ل م, ر ز ق, ب ك ر, ع ش و)
subchannels.synthesis: The garden's order is audible and numerical. Worthless noise is struck from the account, peace remains the only social utterance, and sustenance arrives as an allotted ration on a stable daily cycle.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Failed stewardship produces hunger and entrapment; restored conduct reopens a cultivated enclosure with measured provision.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; successors neglect prayer and follow appetite (19:59), repentance and right action lead into inherited gardens (19:60-63), and provision arrives morning and evening (19:62).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Spiritual neglect becomes an untended estate and milk-starved young animal, while restoration becomes orchard entry, irrigation, and a quiet rationing system.

parent_channels.name: P4 (19:59-76) - Directed Descent and Bound Service

subchannels.name: Ordered descent, placement, and lodging
subchannels.scene_or_process: A descending envoy acts under command, is placed in the proper station, and receives prepared lodging or provision.
subchannels.active_motifs: descent from height (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); caused or repeated descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); placing each thing in its rank (`quranic:root_001492:B004/m01`); lodging and provisions prepared for an arrival (`quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`); binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`); sovereign hand (`quranic:root_001693:B005/m01`); what lies in front or near occurrence (`quranic:root_001693:B008/m01`); interval between parties (`quranic:root_000170:B002/m01`); what remains behind (`quranic:root_000433:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:64 (ن ز ل, ء م ر, ب ي ن, ي د ي, خ ل ف)
subchannels.synthesis: Descent is logistical rather than spontaneous. Command authorizes it, front and rear define orientation, ordered placement fixes the station, and lodging names the provision appropriate to the arriving servant.

subchannels.name: Service as self-restraint, guaranty, and seal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A servant remains at an assigned task by restraining the self, accepting responsibility, and sealing off premature release.
subchannels.active_motifs: restraining the self against distress (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); acting as guarantor and remaining with a group (`quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`); stopper sealing a vessel or well (`quranic:root_000840:B018/m01`); devoted obedience (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`); lordship and ownership (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); repairing and completing what is entrusted (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Patient worship is figured as bounded service. The servant guarantees the obligation and remains within it; the stopper image makes endurance a controlled seal that preserves the assigned contents until the proper opening.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Legitimate service is ordered from above, placed correctly, and sustained by restrained endurance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; descent occurs only by divine command amid what lies before, behind, and between (19:64), followed by patient worship of the Lord of the heavens and earth (19:65).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene combines courier lodging, ranked placement, sovereign hand, guaranty, confinement, and a vessel stopper.

parent_channels.name: P4 (19:59-76) - Judgment as Muster, Tribunal, and Extraction

subchannels.name: Forced muster at the watering place
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group is driven from its station, encircled at a water destination, called into order, and made to arrive in successive files.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering a group while driving it (`quranic:root_000324:B001/m01`); returning to a communal water source (`quranic:root_000333:B003/m01`); encircling a place (`quranic:root_000373:B004/m01`); shepherd's call that gathers a herd (`quranic:root_000836:B006/m01`); arrival at water (`quranic:root_001640:B001/m01`); fixed turn or share at water (`quranic:root_001640:B002/m01`); entering in successive groups (`quranic:root_001640:B007/m01`); gathered heap or raised mass (`quranic:root_000223:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:68 (ح ش ر, ح ض ر, ح و ل, ج ث و); 19:69 (ش ي ع); 19:71 (و ر د)
subchannels.synthesis: The gathering around Hell is lexically organized like forced watering. Herd-call, encirclement, scheduled arrival, and successive entry turn "coming to it" into a controlled muster whose participants cannot choose another source.

subchannels.name: Knee-to-knee tribunal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Defendants kneel in close confrontation before an authority who knows, determines, and selects.
subchannels.active_motifs: kneeling on both knees (`quranic:root_000223:B001/m01`); litigating while kneeling before a ruler (`quranic:root_000333:B006/m01`); binding judicial determination (`quranic:root_000292:B001/m01`); decisive decree (`quranic:root_001237:B001/m01`); complete knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); pulling a selected party from its place (`quranic:root_001489:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Kneeling is both posture and juridical placement. Presence before authority becomes contested hearing; knowledge identifies the parties; determination makes the result binding; extraction executes the distinction.

subchannels.name: Fire tending, straightening, and rescue
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fuel intensifies a fire, material is exposed to heat for straightening, and selected pieces are pulled free while others remain.
subchannels.active_motifs: kindling and strengthening fire with fuel (`quranic:root_000836:B005/m01`); entering and enduring fire (`quranic:root_000880:B003/m01`); heating an object to straighten it (`quranic:root_000880:B004/m01`); extracting from a fixed place (`quranic:root_001489:B001/m01`); escape by separation (`quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`); stripping or drawing material free (`quranic:root_001476:B003/m01`); leaving something in place (`quranic:root_001638:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The judgment scene resembles controlled heat treatment. Fire is fed, exposure tests and straightens, and rescue is an extraction operation that separates viable material from what is left in the furnace.

subchannels.name: Drawn bow at the point of separation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A cord is tensioned, bow material is stripped and prepared, and a projectile is released across a separating line.
subchannels.active_motifs: drawing a bowstring (`quranic:root_001489:B002/m01`); limb or part separated from what adjoined it (`quranic:root_000170:B008/m01`); long twisted rope (`quranic:root_000796:B002/m01`); extracting bow staves and string from wood or hide (`quranic:root_001476:B003/m02`); tanning bark or tree material (`quranic:root_000737:B008/m01`); stirring embers into flame (`quranic:root_001639:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Selection under tension takes the form of archery manufacture and release. Wood, hide, cord, and fire prepare the bow; drawing stores force; separation marks the point at which the selected element leaves the mixed field.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A mixed population is driven to an appointed site, sorted under authority, exposed to fire, and selectively removed.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the doubters are gathered around Hell, the fiercest faction is plucked out, all arrive at it, and the protected are rescued while wrongdoers remain kneeling (19:68-72).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Hell becomes a forced watering place, the court a knee-to-knee confrontation, and selection a drawn-bow and fire-straightening operation.

parent_channels.name: P4 (19:59-76) - Social Value Reversed Across Time

subchannels.name: Furnished assembly, priced station, and weak support
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rival groups display furnishings, appearance, meeting place, and supporters as evidence of superior rank.
subchannels.active_motifs: abundant household furnishings (`quranic:root_000010:B002/m01`); visible appearance or reflected presentation (`quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`); residence or assembly station (`quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`); valuation and pricing (`quranic:root_001273:B010/m01`); council or social gathering (`quranic:root_001486:B001/m01`); organized host of supporters (`quranic:root_000264:B001/m01`); lack of force (`quranic:root_000909:B001/m01`); value selected as better (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Status is staged as a public appraisal of house, body, venue, and entourage. The later disclosure of weak support exposes the pricing error: visible abundance had been treated as security.

subchannels.name: Bound generation reduced to wasteland
subchannels.scene_or_process: A generation is bound together in one time, then its collective strength is erased into dry, dangerous terrain.
subchannels.active_motifs: people joined together by a bond (`quranic:root_001221:B001/m01`); generation sharing one age (`quranic:root_001221:B005/m01`); destruction and disappearance (`quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`); rainless land (`quranic:root_001596:B005/m01`); deadly wilderness or chasm (`quranic:root_001596:B006/m01`); temporal precedence (`quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:74 (ق ب ل, ق ر ن, ه ل ك)
subchannels.synthesis: A generation's apparent cohesion is temporary. The same group that is tied together by era and association can be reduced to an unwatered expanse where its former display offers no route or shelter.

subchannels.name: Reward as what returns, remains, and increases
subchannels.scene_or_process: Action sends value forward; its return is measured by durability and increase rather than immediate possession.
subchannels.active_motifs: return to a former place or source (`quranic:root_000209:B001/m01`); recompense returning to its worker (`quranic:root_000209:B002/m01`); return to owner or proper place (`quranic:root_000555:B001/m01`); durable remainder (`quranic:root_000142:B001/m01`); retained good or revenue (`quranic:root_000142:B002/m01`); organic increase (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); provisions stored for travel (`quranic:root_000657:B005/m01`); guidance to the route (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:76 (ز ي د, ه د ي, ب ق ي, ث و ب, ر د د)
subchannels.synthesis: The closing valuation is temporal accounting. Reward is what returns from action, enduring deeds are the remainder that does not vanish, and guidance becomes travel provision for reaching the final point of return.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Visible status is appraised against outcomes that unfold beyond the immediate display.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; unbelievers compare station and assembly (19:73), earlier generations had finer goods and appearance yet were destroyed (19:74), and enduring deeds have the better reward and return (19:76).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Household furniture, market valuation, military support, tied generations, wasteland, and returning payment form one temporal appraisal system.

parent_channels.name: P5 (19:77-98) - Claim, Covenant, Property, and Exact Account

subchannels.name: Speculative wealth claim and covenant warranty
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claimant asserts future assets without inspection, while a valid protected covenant would require known terms and warranty.
subchannels.active_motifs: acquiring and multiplying wealth (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`); descendant as possessed future increase (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`); inspecting a hidden matter (`quranic:root_000945:B003/m01`); scout sent to discover what lies ahead (`quranic:root_000945:B004/m01`); ascent to a lookout (`quranic:root_000945:B006/m01`); unseen or absent matter (`quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`); protected pact and security (`quranic:root_001055:B003/m01`); purchase warranty and written condition (`quranic:root_001055:B006/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:77 (م و ل, و ل د); 19:78 (ط ل ع, غ ي ب, ع ه د)
subchannels.synthesis: The boast is exposed as an uninspected acquisition claim. Reconnaissance imagery asks whether the claimant has actually reached a vantage over the unseen; contract imagery asks whether a valid warranty or covenant secures the promised assets.

subchannels.name: Written liability extended through time
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech is entered into a binding record, supplied with ink, and carried forward as an expanding liability.
subchannels.active_motifs: written document (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); record imposing judgment or obligation (`quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`); articulated claim (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); negotiation over an affair (`quranic:root_001272:B009/m01`); connected increase that supplies another amount (`quranic:root_001407:B002/m01`); extended term or deadline (`quranic:root_001407:B004/m01`); ink replenished for writing (`quranic:root_001407:B005/m01`); inherited estate removed from the speaker (`quranic:root_001639:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The spoken boast becomes documentary liability. Writing fixes the words, ink sustains the record, temporal extension enlarges rather than erases the obligation, and inheritance transfers away the very assets the claimant treated as permanently his.

subchannels.name: Intercession as adjoining property right
subchannels.scene_or_process: A petitioner may join another's case only through recognized standing, ownership, and covenant.
subchannels.active_motifs: intercessor joining a petitioner's case (`quranic:root_000802:B002/m01`); preemption right adjoining one property to another (`quranic:root_000802:B003/m01`); ownership and disposition (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`); sovereignty (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); governing support or mainstay (`quranic:root_001444:B005/m01`); protected covenant (`quranic:root_001055:B003/m01`); contractual warranty (`quranic:root_001055:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Intercession is clarified through property law. Joining another's claim requires standing analogous to an adjoining owner's preemption right; ultimate ownership and a recognized covenant determine whether such joinder is valid.

subchannels.name: Pebble census and separated individuals
subchannels.scene_or_process: A population is counted with tangible counters, entered one by one, and separated like large beads or pearls.
subchannels.active_motifs: numerical counting (`quranic:root_000989:B001/m01`); fixed counted period (`quranic:root_000989:B003/m01`); recurring count or appointed time (`quranic:root_000989:B005/m01`); small counting stones (`quranic:root_000332:B001/m01`); exhaustive enumeration (`quranic:root_000332:B002/m01`); solitary arrival one by one (`quranic:root_001141:B001/m01`); large pearl separated in a string (`quranic:root_001141:B002/m01`); entering a name in a register (`quranic:root_001283:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Enumeration is concrete and individuating. Pebbles make quantity graspable, the register fixes identity, and the pearl image preserves the paradox that each member belongs to a counted whole yet arrives distinctly separated.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Unsupported future claims are converted into written liability, tested against valid covenant and property right, and settled person by person.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; a claim to future wealth and children is questioned by unseen knowledge or covenant, recorded and extended into punishment, inherited away, and followed by exact enumeration and solitary arrival (19:77-80, 87, 94-95).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene activates reconnaissance, purchase warranty, preemption rights, ledgers, timed liabilities, counting stones, and separated pearls.

parent_channels.name: P5 (19:77-98) - Divergent Processions to Authority and Water

subchannels.name: Delegation approaching a sovereign
subchannels.scene_or_process: A protected group is mustered, travels under a lead figure, and arrives as a recognized embassy before a ruler.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering and conducting a group (`quranic:root_000324:B001/m01`); diplomatic delegation to a sovereign (`quranic:root_001665:B001/m01`); lead animal ahead of the train (`quranic:root_001665:B002/m01`); rapid dispatch (`quranic:root_001665:B004/m01`); being set out on a journey (`quranic:root_001665:B007/m01`); self-protection against harm (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); mercy and beneficent care (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:85 (ي و م, ح ش ر, و ق ي, ر ح م, و ف د)
subchannels.synthesis: The protected do not arrive as captives. Their group has diplomatic form: a lead, a dispatch, a journey, and recognized access to sovereign mercy.

subchannels.name: Herd driven to a terminal water point
subchannels.scene_or_process: Another group is driven in file like livestock toward water, but its destination converts expected relief into penal arrival.
subchannels.active_motifs: driving livestock or captives (`quranic:root_000762:B001/m01`); herd following in one track (`quranic:root_000762:B012/m01`); arrival at water (`quranic:root_001640:B001/m01`); fixed water turn (`quranic:root_001640:B002/m01`); cutting or harvesting produce (`quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`); dry remnants after harvest (`quranic:root_000239:B002/m01`); criminal earning (`quranic:root_000239:B003/m01`); culpable offense (`quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`); market to which goods are driven (`quranic:root_000762:B005/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:86 (س و ق, ج ر م, و ر د)
subchannels.synthesis: The criminals' procession fuses droving, watering, harvest, and market delivery. They move as a managed herd toward an appointed source, but criminal "earning" turns them into the harvested yield delivered to that destination.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Final destination is disclosed by how a group is assembled, led, and received.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the protected are gathered as a delegation to the Merciful, while criminals are driven toward Hell as a thirsty herd (19:85-86).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Diplomatic arrival, lead animals, livestock droving, water turns, harvest residue, market delivery, and criminal earning occupy the same transport frame.

parent_channels.name: P5 (19:77-98) - Structural Collapse and Acoustic Erasure

subchannels.name: Woven canopy and failed foundation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A roof-like woven structure tears, its hard supports split, and a mountain-sized load collapses with a roar.
subchannels.active_motifs: sky as roof or overhanging canopy (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); opening and tearing cloth, earth, or hand (`quranic:root_001165:B001/m01`); fissure through earth or mountain (`quranic:root_000807:B001/m01`); split timber or cloth (`quranic:root_000807:B006/m01`); solid mountain mass (`quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`); substrate too hard to excavate (`quranic:root_000217:B005/m01`); tightly woven mountain fabric (`quranic:root_000217:B007/m01`); severe structural demolition (`quranic:root_001580:B001/m01`); crash and reverberation (`quranic:root_001580:B004/m01`); falling from height (`quranic:root_000402:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:90 (س م و, ف ط ر, ش ق ق, ء ر ض, خ ر ر, ج ب ل, ه د د)
subchannels.synthesis: Cosmic rupture is described as a failure of both fabric and masonry. The canopy tears like cloth, the ground opens, hard supports lose integrity, and the mountain load collapses with audible structural force.

subchannels.name: From destruction to inaudible buried trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: A generation is eradicated until only buried or dried material might remain, below the threshold of sight and hearing.
subchannels.active_motifs: complete destruction and disappearance (`quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`); rainless erased land (`quranic:root_001596:B005/m01`); sensory annihilation (`quranic:root_000321:B001/m01`); perception by direct sense (`quranic:root_000321:B002/m01`); faint unseen movement (`quranic:root_000321:B003/m01`); auditory perception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); faint distant sound (`quranic:root_000591:B001/m01`); buried treasure or mineral (`quranic:root_000591:B004/m01`); dry standing stalk after leaves depart (`quranic:root_000591:B005/m01`); generation sharing one time (`quranic:root_001221:B005/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:98 (ه ل ك, ق ب ل, ق ر ن, ح س س, ء ح د, س م ع, ر ك ز)
subchannels.synthesis: Extinction proceeds beyond death to failure of detection. Even the faint motion or distant murmur by which hidden life might be sensed is gone; buried mineral and dry stalk remain only as latent models of a trace too reduced to answer.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A false kinship claim first tears the world's load-bearing fabric and finally leaves no perceivable trace of earlier communities.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the heavens split, earth cracks, and mountains fall (19:90), while destroyed generations leave neither sensed presence nor faint sound (19:98).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The cosmos becomes woven canopy, split cloth, hard foundation, collapsing wall, impact roar, buried metal, and dry stalk.

parent_channels.name: P5 (19:77-98) - False Support Reversing Into Pressure

subchannels.name: Acquired ally becomes opposing claimant
subchannels.scene_or_process: A party takes a power as its own support, but the supposed ally repudiates the relation and stands opposite.
subchannels.active_motifs: acquisition for oneself (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); made object of worship (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); strength and protected status (`quranic:root_001008:B001/m01`); reinforcement by joining one support to another (`quranic:root_001008:B004/m01`); incompatible opposition (`quranic:root_000905:B001/m01`); equal counterparty or rival (`quranic:root_000905:B002/m01`); repudiation and disavowal (`quranic:root_001307:B005/m01`); subjection made into servitude (`quranic:root_000973:B004/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:81 (ء خ ذ, د و ن, ء ل ه, ع ز ز); 19:82 (ك ف ر, ع ب د, ض د د)
subchannels.synthesis: The worshippers construct a support relation through acquisition and reinforcement. Its reversal is exact: the ally repudiates the bond, becomes a counterparty, and turns the intended source of honor into opposition.

subchannels.name: Incitement as boiling, crowding, and counted pressure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Remote agents are released to apply repeated pressure, compressing and agitating a group while its term is exactly counted.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispatch and release (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); rebellious remote agent (`quranic:root_000796:B004/m01`); distance and disconnection (`quranic:root_000796:B001/m01`); long tightening rope (`quranic:root_000796:B002/m01`); boiling with audible hiss (`quranic:root_000028:B002/m01`); bodies compressed into a crowded space (`quranic:root_000028:B003/m01`); lunar adjustment between months and years (`quranic:root_000028:B006/m01`); premature haste (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`); recurring appointed count (`quranic:root_000989:B005/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:83 (ر س ل, ش ط ن, ك ف ر, ء ز ز); 19:84 (ع ج ل, ع د د)
subchannels.synthesis: Incitement is active pressure rather than abstract temptation. Agents at a distance tighten, boil, and crowd the group, yet the delay is not disorder: lunar and recurring counts fix its limit and answer the command not to hurry.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Supports acquired for strength become opposing or coercive forces.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; adopted gods cease to support their worshippers and become opponents (19:81-82), while dispatched devils agitate the unbelievers under a measured delay (19:83-84).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Alliance reverses like a legal counterparty, while agitation becomes boiling, crowd compression, rope pressure, and lunar accounting.

parent_channels.name: P5 (19:77-98) - Speech Meeting Affection or Resistance

subchannels.name: Easy tongue against lateral contention
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fluent message moves readily forward, while resistant hearers turn sideways, obstruct, and prolong dispute.
subchannels.active_motifs: opening and ease after difficulty (`quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`); light compliant gait (`quranic:root_001694:B005/m01`); downward twisting of fiber (`quranic:root_001694:B009/m01`); speech organ (`quranic:root_001355:B001/m01`); fluency and argument (`quranic:root_001355:B003/m01`); language and delivered report (`quranic:root_001355:B006/m01`); good news that opens the face (`quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`); warning that activates caution (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`); fierce disputation (`quranic:root_001351:B001/m01`); turning to either side (`quranic:root_001351:B002/m01`); holding someone back (`quranic:root_001351:B006/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:97 (ي س ر, ل س ن, ب ش ر, و ق ي, ن ذ ر, ق و م, ل د د)
subchannels.synthesis: Ease describes both articulation and responsive motion: the message is twisted into a usable strand and follows a light gait. Contentious resistance moves laterally, blocks forward passage, and converts hearing into adversarial exchange.

subchannels.name: Affection and the reversal of Wadd
subchannels.scene_or_process: Affection is assigned to faithful action, while the same lexical field remembers an idol whose name promised a counterfeit attachment.
subchannels.active_motifs: mutual love and attachment (`quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`); desire for a wished outcome (`quranic:root_001634:B002/m01`); Wadd as an idol-name (`quranic:root_001634:B005/m01`); trusting assent (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); sound and reparative action (`quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`); appointing a new state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 19:96 (ء م ن, ع م ل, ص ل ح, ج ع ل, ر ح م, و د د)
subchannels.synthesis: The love granted to faithful action is sharpened by the same root's idol-name. Attachment is no longer projected onto an acquired deity; it is made as the social outcome of trust and reparative conduct.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A delivered message reveals its hearers by the movement it elicits, easy reception and affection or lateral resistance and dispute.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the message is made easy on the tongue to announce and warn (19:97), while believers receive affection (19:96) and the contentious resist (19:97).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Ease becomes compliant gait and downward twist, contention becomes side-to-side dosing and blockage, and divine affection reverses the name of an idol.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 (19:1-15) - Rain-catching stone cistern
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Rain is caught in rock, held in a covered depression, and drawn by pulley and handled bucket.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hidden well or covered depression (`quranic:root_000428:B002/m01`); excavated reservoir holding water (`quranic:root_000018:B006/m01`); new rock pool or well (`quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`); rain basin in stone (`quranic:root_001685:B003/m01`); abundant gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`); rotating well pulley (`quranic:root_000143:B006/m01`); one-handled water bucket (`quranic:root_000737:B011/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The branches form a compact water-capture installation: a covered stone depression receives rain, stores it, and makes it retrievable through pulley and bucket. It gives material form to hidden mercy becoming available provision.

parent_channels.name: S2. P2 (19:16-40) - Apotropaic protection against the eye
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A charm or spoken protection blocks a harmful gaze and preserves the exposed person from loss of standing.
parent_channels.active_motifs: protective incantation or amulet (`quranic:root_001059:B002/m01`); injury by the evil eye (`quranic:root_001069:B004/m01`); charm that arrests sight or relationship (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); ordinary ocular sight (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); direct visual perception (`quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`); act that makes a person fall from others' esteem (`quranic:root_000719:B008/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Mary's invocation of refuge and later public exposure activate a coherent protective scene. The amulet and evil-eye senses make reputation and bodily safety jointly vulnerable to hostile sight, while protection interrupts that gaze.

parent_channels.name: S3. P3 (19:41-58) - Verbal stoning answered by peace
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Injurious speech is thrown like stones, then answered by a non-retaliatory greeting and a promise of covering.
parent_channels.active_motifs: abusive words as stone-throwing (`quranic:root_000547:B002/m01`); obscene or abandoned speech (`quranic:root_001578:B003/m01`); translation into another tongue (`quranic:root_000547:B009/m01`); articulated statement (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); peaceful settlement rather than combat (`quranic:root_000737:B004/m01`); forgiveness that covers and protects (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); attentive kindness (`quranic:root_000344:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The father's threat already contains a verbal form of stoning, and abandonment itself carries a branch of foul speech. Abraham's answer changes the discourse operation from projectile injury to peace and protective covering.

parent_channels.name: S4. P3 (19:41-58) - Migration measured in bare and worn feet
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Separation becomes a physical migration whose cost is registered in the traveler's feet.
parent_channels.active_motifs: bodily withdrawal to one side (`quranic:root_001009:B001/m01`); traveler camping apart from the group (`quranic:root_001009:B008/m01`); leaving one abode for another (`quranic:root_001578:B002/m01`); walking barefoot (`quranic:root_000344:B005/m01`); foot or hoof worn thin by travel (`quranic:root_000344:B006/m01`); straight road (`quranic:root_000858:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Abraham's withdrawal is not only social distance. The branch senses trace a traveler leaving habitation, camping apart, and wearing the feet thin along a route, making separation a costly embodied journey.

parent_channels.name: S5. P3 (19:41-58) - Lineage as scattered seed and following young
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A lineage is dispersed like seed yet remains continuous because young animals follow their dams and selected stock is gathered.
parent_channels.active_motifs: scattering grain or powder (`quranic:root_000511:B002/m01`); animal gestation (`quranic:root_000357:B002/m02`); tree fruit carried on the branch (`quranic:root_000357:B002/m03`); young animal following its mother (`quranic:root_000186:B006/m01`); calf following the dam (`quranic:root_000175:B007/m01`); grazing livestock as wealth (`quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`); gathering produce or resources (`quranic:root_000220:B001/m01`); selecting and drawing near (`quranic:root_000220:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 19:43 (ت ب ع); 19:58 (ذ ر ر, ح م ل, ج ب ي, ت ل و, ن ع م)
parent_channels.synthesis: Descendants are imagined through two compatible propagation systems. Seed is dispersed across ground, while young animals maintain continuity by following the maternal line; selection gathers that dispersed life into a guided succession.

parent_channels.name: S6. Honeycomb extraction from a hive
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A honey gatherer carries dedicated gear to a hive, removes comb before pressing, and uses specialized implements to extract its contents.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather coat or pouch carried by the honey gatherer (`quranic:root_000447:B006/m01`); hive as the honey source (`quranic:root_000827:B002/m01`); implements and action of gathering honey (`quranic:root_000827:B002/m02`); honey still enclosed in wax before pressing (`quranic:root_000822:B007/m01`); dedicated extraction implement (`quranic:root_001489:B010/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The motifs form a complete extraction practice: carried gear reaches the hive, tools separate comb from its place, and pressing turns wax-enclosed sweetness into available food. This materializes the Surah's repeated movement from concealment to provision and public evidence: what is hidden becomes sustaining through careful disclosure.

parent_channels.name: S7. Rigging a camel's hump for riding
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A camel's back is leveled and layered with an undercloth, outer pad, and wooden saddle frame until it can carry a rider.
parent_channels.active_motifs: hump or withers leveled like bedding (`quranic:root_001451:B004/m01`); under-saddle cloth against the camel's back (`quranic:root_001684:B011/m01`); saddlecloth or pad fitted around the hump (`quranic:root_000766:B010/m01`); bare wooden saddle frame (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The separate parts form one load-bearing assembly: the living hump is prepared as a bed, protected by an underlay, covered by a riding pad, and stabilized by wood. This materializes the Surah's processions by distinguishing prepared, ridden transport from the thirsty herd driven on foot, sharpening the contrast between honored delegation and compelled arrival.

parent_channels.name: S8. A postpartum date-and-fenugreek restorative
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Rendered fat is clarified with dates or grain, cooked with dates and fenugreek, allowed to thicken, and served to a recovering mother.
parent_channels.active_motifs: cooking pot or eating bowl (`quranic:root_000043:B013/m01`); rendered fat or oil used as a condiment (`quranic:root_000064:B006/m01`); butter clarified with dates or grain (`quranic:root_000430:B008/m01`); date-and-fenugreek food used as postpartum medicine (`quranic:root_001148:B012/m01`); liquid thickening and setting at the end of preparation (`quranic:root_000067:B005/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: These motifs specify one restorative recipe rather than a general food field: fat is clarified, medicinal dates and fenugreek are cooked, the mixture reaches its final consistency, and a vessel makes it ready to eat. The scene materializes Mary's command to eat and drink after labor as postpartum recovery, reframing miraculous provision as care directed to an exhausted body.

parent_channels.name: S9. From harvested field to hearth bread
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Cut grain is carried to a threshing floor, trodden with an iron-shod implement, sifted into flour, kneaded, and baked in embers.
parent_channels.active_motifs: field residue remaining after harvest (`quranic:root_000324:B008/m01`); carrying the cut crop to the threshing floor (`quranic:root_000582:B006/m01`); iron-and-wood implement used to tread the grain heap (`quranic:root_000373:B015/m01`); sifting flour through a sieve (`quranic:root_001483:B002/m01`); kneading dough until cohesive (`quranic:root_001444:B001/m01`); bread baked in embers (`quranic:root_000321:B008/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The cluster is a single conversion chain from residual crop to edible bread. Carrying, threshing, sifting, kneading, and baking each alter the material toward nourishment. It supports the garden and provision readings by showing that inherited yield still requires ordered work, and it materializes lasting deeds as labor that transforms a field's remainder into sustaining food.

parent_channels.name: S10. Repeated call, turned body, and counted prayer
